verdicts.why: The episode page for 'Hot Potato Soup' (S4E12) says Daisy takes down May's LMD and Radcliffe takes the Darkhold in the fight, and Wikipedia agrees ('Radcliffe steals the Darkhold'). The current record is right. The claim that the LMD brought it to him comes only from the item page (and the evidence names the wrong episode).

Missing Pieces (S6E1) opens with Enoch waking Fitz from the Cryo-Freeze Chamber early, just before a spiral of energy cuts the Chronicom ship in two. That happens before Daisy and Simmons find the pod a year later.
Trok admits he bought half of the wrecked Chronicom vessel and sends them to it on D'Rill, where they find the chamber empty. The ship was not drifting abandoned in space.
Wikipedia's S3 summary says James 'gives them an ancient Kree device'. Lincoln breaking the crystal deal is extra detail, not a correction, so the current text stands.
After M.O.D.O.K. wrecks the ship, Hank's ants find him and repair it, and he flies it back to Axia. The file is missing this record after the Destroyed step.

Fitz builds the devices but never seals the rift himself. Coulson contains it with the first device in The Real Deal, and Daisy closes it for good with Fitz's second device in The Devil Complex. The proposal leaves out Daisy's final seal.

value.text: In season 5, a monolith sends the team to 2091 and back. Later, a bomb shatters three monoliths, and Coulson, then Daisy, seal the rift they leave behind with devices Fitz builds.

verdicts.why: In Munich (FATWS episode 2), Redwing chases the Flag Smashers' trucks until Karli Morgenthau leaps up and breaks it in half. Sam only gets new Wakandan drones in episode 6.
In the Bulletin attack (S3E6), the fake Daredevil throws his billy club at Karen's gun and stabs Ellison in the gut with a pen, not the club.
The Blip brings back Peter, the Stark suit and the Iron Spider in 2023, and he fights the Outriders in the Iron Spider at the Battle of Earth. The file was missing this step.

Wikipedia: in episode 1 Frank kills the last of the gangs behind his family's deaths. The vest page says he then burns the vest, thinking his war is over. No record covered the first vest being destroyed.
Wikipedia plot: Groot rescues Adam as the Arête is destroyed, Adam saves Quill from dying on the way to Knowhere, and Adam is on Rocket's new Guardians.
Wikipedia's episode 8 summary: Rio makes Billy and Agatha choose who goes with her, and Agatha kisses Rio and dies. This happens after the current episode 8 record.

Wikipedia's episode 9 summary: Agatha, now a ghost, stays with Billy in Westview and sets out with him to find Tommy. It belongs after the new episode 8 death record (both use after 3, so the death must go in first).

Wikipedia plot: inside the Void the Thunderbolts hug Bob and help him take back control, then the group goes along with de Fontaine calling them the New Avengers. The post-credits scene shows Bob with them.

Episode 33 ('Aftershocks', S2E11) comes before episode 41 ('The Dirty Half Dozen'), which ends with Coulson giving Hill the location of Strucker's base. That leads into the Age of Ultron raid, so the raid belongs after step 8 and before Ant-Man.
Episode 64 ('Emancipation') opens after the Sokovia Accords are signed, so episode 54 ('Maveth') happens before Civil War. Civil War belongs after step 11 and before step 12 (episode 66).

FATWS is set in 2024. Episode 128 has the 2019 team in the 1970s, so on either timeline reading it comes before FATWS, and FATWS belongs last. Separately, the file puts Endgame's 2012 scene at its own date; under that rule step 17 would also move up to just after step 2.

Wikipedia: in episode 4 Sylvie unlocks B-15's memories and B-15 helps them defeat Renslayer. In episode 6 B-15 proves to TVA troopers that they are variants. The last event is in episode 6, so the tag is right.

Wikipedia plot: Loki and the gladiators arrive on Asgard to help, Thor sends Loki to trigger Ragnarok, and Thor makes peace with him aboard the Statesman. The file's Ragnarok record stops at Loki's betrayal.

Wikipedia's episode 6 summary supports the record. Maya asks Kazi to leave the Tracksuits with her, he refuses and fights her, and she kills him. So the reason is changed to that instead of the vaguer 'for siding with Fisk'.

value.title: Hawkeye
value.text: In episode 6, Maya kills Kazi when he refuses to break from Fisk, then confronts Fisk herself, and a gunshot rings out.
